related_adrs: ADR-0349/0359 (Jenkins CI runs the drift gate)
title: API contract single-source-of-truth — one Rust-native source generating/validating REST + gRPC + GraphQL
purpose: Target spec for the shared Rust-native contract SSOT + drift gate. Every public/internal API surface (REST/OpenAPI 3.2.0, gRPC/proto3, GraphQL SDL) is GENERATED or VALIDATED from one shared Rust-native source of truth so the three surfaces can never drift. GraphQL is first-class but never hand-maintained — it is derived from the same source as REST and gRPC. Honest non-claim: this records the canonical contract-SSOT model + launch directives; it does not implement the generators, resolvers, brokers, adapters, or the runtime drift gate (those are downstream ChangeSets).

single_source_of_truth.form: Rust-native typed contract definitions (the canonical source); OpenAPI 3.2.0 + proto3 + GraphQL SDL are projections generated/validated from it
single_source_of_truth.principle: one source mastered in exactly one place; the three wire surfaces are derived projections, never independently hand-edited (SSOT single-master).

surfaces.derivation: generated from the Rust source; api-semver gate enforces -vN suffix + metadata (ADR-0342)
generated from the Rust source; tonic/prost adapters consume the generated bindings
FIRST-CLASS but generated/validated from the same Rust source; NO separately hand-maintained GraphQL schema

drift_gate.name: api-contract-ssot-drift (planned)
drift_gate.rule: regenerate the three projections from the Rust source and diff against the committed contracts; any divergence (REST/gRPC/GraphQL out of sync with the source, or GraphQL hand-edited) fails the gate (lockfile-style, like cargo's Cargo.lock check).
drift_gate.ci: runs under Jenkins (ADR-0359) as a required check

messaging_directives.async_contracts: AsyncAPI 3.1.0 for event contracts, also derived from the shared source where events are typed

non_claims: Records the canonical contract-SSOT model + launch directives only.
Does NOT implement the Rust-native generators, the OpenAPI/proto/GraphQL emitters, GraphQL resolvers, the drift gate runtime, message brokers, adapters, or admission controllers.
No runtime, no production readiness; claims stay blocked_until_required_evidence_is_green.
